parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Start of time window (ISO 8601). Defaults to 5 minutes ago.

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: End of time window (ISO 8601). Defaults to now.

parameters.name: environment
parameters.description:
Optional. Filter to services tagged with this environment
(e.g. `production`, `staging`, `dev`). Omit to disable the
environment filter. Ignored when an attribute filter is supplied.
